category_summary: **Cost & Adoption Sentiment** — The batch's clear centerpiece is **@iseff**'s [post calling Hermes **75% cheaper**](/?date=2026-09-28&category=social#item-d2e0ed66cf8c), which drew the highest engagement (289 likes, ~8.9k views) and was amplified by the official **@NousResearch** account — a strong signal of price-driven adoption interest and enthusiastic vendor-community interaction. **Skills Packages & Agent Tooling** — Prioritized community author **@rlaope** dominates this section with [**oh-my-hermes**](/?date=2026-09-28&category=social#item-ae194ab4afa2), an all-in-one bundle of **113+ skills** for hermes-agent covering coding intelligence, long-term memory, subagents, and domain workflows, pitched as a single install replacing scattered tooling; sentiment is builder-forward and convenience-focused, though the [duplicate post (same author, same package)](/?date=2026-09-28&category=social#item-8ab43c188ed3) signals aggressive promotion rather than net-new content. **Evaluation & Calibration** — **@rlaope** also ships [**jeval**](/?date=2026-09-28&category=social#item-21c26e487235), a technically distinctive tool that audits Jev confidence-score calibration from existing logs, outputs a single HTML report, and fails CI on calibration drift — appealing to the quality/reliability-minded segment of the community. **Off-topic** — **Sakana AI**'s [**SAIL**](/?date=2026-09-28&category=social#item-360d295a2fc3) (Scaling In-Context Imitation Learning, with University of Tokyo, presented at #IROS2026) is legitimate lab research but robotics-focused and unrelated to the Hermes ecosystem, earning the lowest ranking. Overall: high-energy, cost-conscious adoption buzz plus a prolific tooling author driving the ecosystem's skills and evaluation story.

But is 0.9 really right 90% of the time, and ...
items.content:
Using Jev? Every answer comes back with a confidence.

But is 0.9 really right 90% of the time, and at what confidence should a human take over?

jeval answers both from your own Jev logs in a single HTML report, and fails your CI when a new model behind jev-latest shifts calibration.

Don't want to learn the CLI? It ships with agent skills: hand it to your coding agent and get the report back.

https://t.co/ycFYZ5bdNs

#jev #skill
